sentences.en: The resolution that a new road be built was passed.
sentences.zh: 关于修建一条新公路的决议被通过了。

sentences.en: The prime minister didn't budge an inch on his resolution.
sentences.zh: 首相没有在自己的决心上让步一寸。

sentences.en: The resolution was passed by the United Nations Security Council.
sentences.zh: 联合国安理会通过了一项决议。

senses.zh: 正式决定，决议 - 决心，决定 - 坚决；坚定；坚毅 - 解决，解答 - 分辨力，分辨率[度]
